entry.title: WATER SUPPLY EMERGENCY - OHAKUNE
entry.content: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <alert xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:emergency:cap:1.2"><identifier>2.49.0.0.554.2.7.494.494</identifier><sender>help@horizons.govt.nz</sender><sent>2026-08-09T01:10:59-00:00</sent><status>Actual</status><msgType>Alert</msgType><scope>Public</scope><info><language>en-US</language><category>Safety</category><event>Alert</event><urgency>Immediate</urgency><severity>Severe</severity><certainty>Observed</certainty><effective>2026-08-09T01:10:59-00:00</effective><expires>2026-08-10T01:10:59-00:00</expires><senderName>Manawatu-Whanganui Civil Defence Emergency Management Group</senderName><headline>WATER SUPPLY EMERGENCY - OHAKUNE</headline><description>WATER SUPPLY EMERGENCY - OHAKUNE Ohakune water supply is off due to an infrastructure issue. DO NOT USE TAP WATER OR FLUSH TOILETS. DRINKING WATER: Bottled water: Ruapehu District Council office, 38 Ayr St; Thames St opposite the Powderhorn; Goldfinch St/Shannon St corner; rear carpark of the Ohakune iSite; Clyde St carpark; and Moore St outside TOP 10 Holiday Park. Water tanker: Council office. Please reuse empty 5L bottles and refill them here. EMERGENCY TOILETS: Port-a-loos; Council office 38 Ayr St, Thames St opposite the Powderhorn, Goldfinch St/Shannon St, Rear carpark of the Ohakune iSITE PLEASE DO NOT USE PUBLIC TOILETS. For updates, visit Ruapehu District Council Facebook page or mwcdem.govt.nz, and listen to local radio stations. Issued by Manawatu-Whanganui Emergency Management Group at 1.10pm on Sun 9 August.</description><area><areaDesc>Ohakune</areaDesc><polygon>-39.41418,175.38695 -39.42426,175.39057 -39.42875,175.41395 -39.42449,175.43052 -39.41219,175.43496 -39.39545,175.42841 -39.39334,175.39794 -39.39765,175.3796 -39.41418,175.38695</polygon></area></info></alert>

entry.content: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <alert xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:emergency:cap:1.2"><identifier>2.49.0.0.554.2.7.495.495</identifier><sender>help@horizons.govt.nz</sender><sent>2026-08-10T03:26:08-00:00</sent><status>Actual</status><msgType>Alert</msgType><scope>Public</scope><info><language>en-US</language><category>Safety</category><event>Alert</event><urgency>Immediate</urgency><severity>Severe</severity><certainty>Observed</certainty><effective>2026-08-10T03:26:08-00:00</effective><expires>2026-08-11T03:26:08-00:00</expires><senderName>Manawatu-Whanganui Civil Defence Emergency Management Group</senderName><headline>WATER SUPPLY EMERGENCY - OHAKUNE</headline><description>WATER SUPPLY EMERGENCY - OHAKUNE Ohakune is without water due to an infrastructure issue. DO NOT TRY TO USE TAP WATER OR FLUSH TOILETS. Water was hoped to be online at 5pm Monday 10 August. However, more time is needed before the water system can operate without possibly causing damage. Water is now expected to be restored by approx. 5pm Tuesday 11 August. Emergency water supplies are available from Ruapehu District Council office at 37 Ayr St. People who have collected water bottles previously can return and reuse water bottles at this same location. Port-a-loos are located at; Council office 37 Ayr St; Thames Street opposite the Powderhorn; Goldfinch Street / Shannon Street; Rear carpark of the Ohakune iSITE. For updates, visit Ruapehu District Council Facebook page or mwcdem.govt.nz, and listen to local radio stations. Issued by Manawatu Whanganui Emergency Management Group at 3.25pm Monday 10 August.</description><area><areaDesc>Ohakune</areaDesc><polygon>-39.41418,175.38695 -39.42426,175.39057 -39.42875,175.41395 -39.42449,175.43052 -39.41219,175.43496 -39.39545,175.42841 -39.39334,175.39794 -39.39765,175.3796 -39.41418,175.38695</polygon></area></info></alert>
